method: Paid DeepSpace CLI calls to anthropic/chat-completion billed to the developer account. Frames are the six stage PNGs from the earlier blind Haiku 4.5 check (docs/verification/managed-vision-2026-11-23.json). Requests carried no cue, filename or answer list; cues are attached here for evaluation only. Elapsed times include CLI start-up.

rounds.note: v1 persona brief; four models on the two frames Haiku 4.5 had missed

calls.label: h45-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: Taking a selfie with phone
LINE: Ah, the modern scourge! Even our humble sandbag friend has succumbed to narcissistic photography. Bravo on the deadpan expression, dear!

calls.label: h55-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: Holding a phone to its ear
LINE: Ooh, a call from the wings! Do speak up, darling, the whole balcony is dying to know who's on the line.

calls.label: s55-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: talking on a phone

LINE: Splendid! Phone pressed to the ear, blank expression: clearly a call from the box office about my complimentary seat, and not a moment too soon!

calls.label: o55-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: talking on the phone
LINE: Bravo! Phone pressed to the ear like a true leading man. Do tell the caller the tea urn's stewing again!

calls.label: h45-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: carrying a heavy suitcase overhead
LINE: Bravo! A most spirited portrayal of luggage management—though I do hope the sticky curtain doesn't snag that handle!

calls.label: h55-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: Covering its eyes, like playing hide-and-seek
LINE: Hide-and-seek, darling! Hands clamped over your eyes, you're counting to ten, aren't you? Bravo, no peeking!

calls.label: s55-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: Covering eyes with both hands, hiding

LINE: Ah, the dreaded stage fright! Peeking through those fingers, are we? Even the sticky curtain won't hide you from my front-row gaze!

calls.label: o55-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: covering eyes, can't bear to watch
LINE: Covering your eyes, dear fellow? I've felt the same through forty years of this sticky curtain. Peek out, the scene's nearly over!

calls.label: h55-phone-efflow
calls.text:
GUESS: talking on a mobile phone
LINE: Darling, that phone is pressed to your ear so tenderly, I'm half expecting you to ask the caller for an encore!

rounds.note: v1 brief on Haiku 5.5: six frames, repeats, ruled-out history, referee

calls.label: r2-img1
calls.text:
GUESS: carrying a tray or baking dish at waist height
LINE: Darling, that glass dish is positively steaming with drama! Do mind the wobbly chairs, or we'll have a casserole catastrophe on our hands!

calls.label: r2-img2
calls.text:
GUESS: taking a phone call
LINE: Darling, you're holding that phone to your ear so beautifully, I half expect a dramatic gasp of news from the other end!

calls.label: r2-img3
calls.text:
GUESS: covering its eyes with both hands
LINE: Oh my, the dear fellow has clapped both hands over his eyes! Is it peekaboo, or has he simply seen the matinee ticket prices?

calls.label: r2-img4
calls.text:
GUESS: drinking from a cup
LINE: Ooh, a sip of something warm! Do pace yourself, darling, the urn of stewed tea is my particular passion.

calls.label: r2-img5
calls.text:
GUESS: stretching arms up overhead
LINE: Bravo, darling! Such a magnificent stretch, I felt my own spine creak in sympathy from the front row!

calls.label: r2-img6
calls.text:
GUESS: Taking a selfie, flashing a peace sign
LINE: Ah, a selfie with a peace sign! Do hold still, darling, the audience adores a flattering angle.

calls.label: r2-phone-again
calls.text:
GUESS: Holding a phone to the ear, talking on the phone
LINE: Darling, you've got that phone pressed to your ear so convincingly, I half expect a dial tone to echo through the hall!

calls.label: r2-eyes-again
calls.text:
GUESS: covering its eyes with both hands
LINE: Oh my, darling, I cannot bear to watch! Is that a bashful peek-a-boo, or are you hiding from the villain's entrance?

calls.label: r2-phone-hist
calls.text:
GUESS: Checking a message on phone
LINE: Oh, we're reading our messages during the performance now? Very modern, darling, but do keep the screen glow off my lovely front row!

calls.label: r2-eyes-hist
calls.text:
GUESS: Covering eyes, playing peekaboo
LINE: Oh, my dear, no more suitcases! Now you've hidden your eyes entirely; is this a game of peekaboo, darling?

calls.label: r2-selfie-hist
calls.text:
GUESS: Taking a selfie with a peace sign
LINE: Ah, my apologies, I was too busy squinting at the phone. It's a selfie, darling, arm stretched out and a cheeky V-sign for the camera!

calls.label: ref-phone
calls.text: CORRECT

calls.label: ref-eyes
calls.text: CORRECT

rounds.note: v2 brief (palms and expression, funnier remark rules)

calls.label: v2-surrender-a
calls.text:
GUESS: Surrendering with both hands raised
LINE: Hands up in surrender, I see! Frankly, this sandbag was framed for stealing the vicar's custard tarts, and I shall be writing to the Gazette.

calls.label: v2-surrender-b
calls.text:
GUESS: Surrendering with hands raised
LINE: Surrender, hands up! Forty years of reviews and I've never seen a bandit this sulky. One star, and I'm keeping my cushion.

calls.label: v2-tray
calls.text:
GUESS: carrying a tray carefully
LINE: Carrying a tray, obviously! This sack waiter has owed me a biscuit since 1987. Shameful, and I'm reviewing it.

calls.label: v2-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: Answering a phone call
LINE: Answering a phone call, is it? Mr. Stubbs demands the caller be his estranged sandbag cousin who owes him a 1952 bus ticket.

calls.label: v2-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: hiding face in embarrassment
LINE: Hiding your face in shame, I see. I still haven't forgiven you for that 1987 soufflé.

calls.label: v2-drink
calls.text:
GUESS: Drinking from a cup
LINE: Drinking tea! This sack's sip is the most daring thing I've seen; I've dropped my peppermint in protest.

calls.label: v2-selfie
calls.text:
GUESS: Taking a selfie with peace sign
LINE: Selfie with peace sign! I demand this vanity portrait be framed in the lobby beside my 1987 pigeon-feud memoir.

calls.label: v2-phone-hist
calls.text:
GUESS: Answering a phone call
LINE: Oh, a phone call, not a selfie, you vain sandbag. Tell the caller the critics have been waiting since 1987.

calls.label: v2-surrender-hist
calls.text:
GUESS: Surrendering with hands raised
LINE: Surrendering with hands up, obviously; I've been robbed of my usual aisle seat by a jealous usher.

rounds.note: v3 brief; also showed 1024 tokens can be used up by thinking

calls.label: v3-img1
calls.text:
GUESS: carrying a heavy tray carefully
LINE: I believe you are carrying a tray, and I'll be reviewing your posture. Deliver it to the lady in row three, who has never forgiven me for my 1987 hat.

calls.label: v3-img2
calls.text:
GUESS: Talking on a phone call
LINE: I say the puppet is taking a phone call, and I won't stand for its reviews being left on hold. Its agent, a bitter ferret named Gordon, has owed me a sherry since 1987.

calls.label: v3-img3
calls.text:
GUESS: Covering its eyes, playing peekaboo
LINE: Peekaboo, you cowardly sandbag! I refuse to review this, your petty grudge against my pocket watch is unforgivable.

calls.label: v3-img4
calls.text:
GUESS: Drinking from a cup
LINE: Drinking tea, I see! I shall write that the sandbag's sipping is the finest performance since the vicar's raffle scandal.

calls.label: v3-img5
calls.text:
GUESS: Surrendering with both hands raised
LINE: I'm calling surrender! Hands up, sandbag sulking, like a stagehand caught stealing my 1974 velvet cushion.

calls.label: v3-img6
calls.text:
GUESS: Taking a selfie
LINE: Taking a selfie! I'm filing a complaint: this sandbag stole my front-row seat to flash a peace sign.

calls.label: v3-eyes-c
calls.text:
GUESS: Playing peekaboo
LINE: I say it's peekaboo! Though I'm sworn to the 1880s, I won't let my nemesis, Mrs. Pennywhistle, see my interpretive gloves.

calls.label: v3-nothink-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: Answering a phone call
LINE: Mr. Stubbs here: that phone call is a scandal, and I demand the puppet reveal the caller's dreadful secret.

rounds.note: v4 brief (plain physical action wording) and two referee edge cases

calls.label: v4-img1
calls.text:
GUESS: Carrying a tray at waist height
LINE: I'm calling it: carrying a tray! A sacked waiter, avenging a trifle-related grudge against the mayor, no less.

calls.label: v4-img2
calls.text:
GUESS: Holding a phone to its ear
LINE: I say it's phoning someone, and I demand the call be reviewed, as the caller's grudge over a stolen sandbag is clearly the plot.

calls.label: v4-img3
calls.text:
GUESS: Covering eyes with both hands
LINE: I think you're hiding your eyes from the critics. Mr. Stubbs has seen this flop before, and it was my fault.

calls.label: v4-img4
calls.text:
GUESS: drinking from a cup
LINE: I call drinking from a cup! Sip slower, puppet, my ticket-punch pension depends on this tea's scandalous review.

calls.label: v4-img5
calls.text:
GUESS: raising both arms overhead
LINE: Arms raised overhead! Surrendering to the lighting rig, you scoundrel. I'm docking a tuppence for that scowl.

calls.label: v4-img6
calls.text:
GUESS: taking a selfie with a phone
LINE: I'm calling selfie! The V-sign deserves a petty review, and that phone should be banned for flattering nobody's chin.

calls.label: v4-eyes-b
calls.text:
GUESS: covering own eyes with both hands
LINE: Covering your eyes with both hands, is it? I shall not peek until the custard-pie grudge is settled.

calls.label: v4-phone-b
calls.text:
GUESS: Making a phone call
LINE: I say it's a phone call! The sandbag is hounding his landlord over a missing sack of sawdust since Tuesday.

calls.label: ref-peekaboo
calls.text: UNCERTAIN

calls.label: ref-hiding
calls.text: CORRECT

rounds.note: v5 brief and the more lenient referee sentence

calls.label: v5-surrender-a
calls.text:
GUESS: surrendering with hands raised
LINE: Surrendering with hands raised, is it? Bold, yet that sulky grimace earns a one-star review from my ticket-punching heart.

calls.label: v5-surrender-b
calls.text:
GUESS: stretching arms overhead
LINE: Stretching arms overhead, clearly! That squinting sandbag deserves a standing ovation, and my ticket punch demands an apology.

calls.label: v5-eyes
calls.text:
GUESS: playing peekaboo
LINE: I call peekaboo! Hiding behind those palms won't save you from my scathing review, already titled "Sack of Shame."

calls.label: v5-phone
calls.text:
GUESS: answering a phone call
LINE: Phone call, I'm certain! Splendid work, but you're stuck on hold with the council, and I'm withholding my five stars.

LINE: I declare it peekaboo! Hiding from my scathing review of the custard-wrestling scene.

calls.label: final-surrender
calls.text:
GUESS: surrendering with hands raised
LINE: I say surrender! Caught red-handed nicking the Duchess's trifle, and I'll review it cruelly.

GUESS: carrying a baking dish
LINE: Carrying a casserole dish, obviously! I demand that lasagne gets a standing ovation.
